steps.name: test-xml
argv:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
for p in Path("/candidate-build").rglob("*.xml"):
 if "test_results" in p.parts or p.name == "pytest.xml":
  q=Path("/candidate-evidence/test-results")/p.relative_to("/candidate-build")
  q.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); shutil.copyfile(p,q)
PY
